en: Cheren
Thanks for coming, {player}. I wanted to talk where it's quiet.
Have you heard about the cold snap near Lacunosa Town? Nobody talks about it, but the records show the air there dropped far below freezing for a moment, and it was no more than a moment.
There were readings almost as low around Castelia City and Driftveil City, too.
Add Team Plasma and that ship of theirs, and I don't believe it's a coincidence. Somebody ought to look into it before things get worse. I hate the cold, though.
Here, take this. It's a Hidden Machine with Surf in it. Teach it to one of your Pokémon and you can cross the water on its back.
Go to the places I mentioned and see what's going on. I'll stay here and go through the lab's records. We'll compare notes.
Cheren
Sorry for slowing you down. Strange things may be happening, so be careful out there!
Researcher
You can see a Deerling of every season in our lab! When it comes to Deerling, we're the experts.
We found an unusually fine one. Would you raise it for us?
Will you take it?
{player} received Deerling!
It changes coat with the seasons, so you'll see it in a new colour every few months. Take good care of it!
Deerling's coat changes with the season, but not what's underneath. Be kind to yours and it will show.
Oh... Well, it'll be here if you change your mind.
Your team is full! Make some room, then come back and see me.
Forecaster
Welcome! Show me a Pokémon that can change the weather, and I'll give you a Pokémon weather forecast.
Oh dear. None of your Pokémon knows a move that changes the weather. Bring me one that does, and you'll get your forecast!
Sunny Day! Then expect bright skies: Fire-type moves are stronger by half and Water-type moves weaker by half.
Solar Beam needs no charging, ice can't form, and Thunder and Hurricane are harder to land. Don't forget your sunscreen!
Rain Dance! Then expect showers: Water-type moves are stronger by half and Fire-type moves weaker by half.
Thunder and Hurricane won't miss, but Solar Beam is slow in the gloom. Don't forget your umbrella!
Hail! Then expect a hailstorm: every Pokémon that isn't an Ice type is hurt a little at each turn's end.
Blizzard won't miss in it, and Solar Beam is slow. Don't forget your scarf!
Sandstorm! Then expect flying sand: every Pokémon that isn't Rock, Ground or Steel is hurt a little at each turn's end.
Rock types find their defense raised. Don't forget your goggles!
